name: The Missing Map
introduction: Pell lowers her voice. 'A map of the old river is missing from the vault. The copyist in the stacks borrowed it last. Find out where it went.'
progress: You know where the map is. Pell should hear it.
completion: Pell closes her eyes in relief, then presses a brass key into your hand. 'Then the vault can be whole again. Go and see.'
